deciding_rule: A change to heading 02.01 through 02.10 from any other chapter
reasoning: Following precedent JP1240803, the CPTPP product-specific rule for heading 02.06 requires a change to heading 02.01 through 02.10 from any other chapter (CC). Live bovine animals (Chapter 1), even when treated as non-originating materials, are slaughtered and processed into edible offal (heading 0206.29) in Canada, a CPTPP party. This satisfies the required chapter change.

deciding_rule: CC except from materials of heading 11.08
reasoning: Following precedents JP1241166 and JP1241015, the product-specific rule for heading 35.05 under the Japan-EU EPA is 'CC except from materials of heading 11.08'. The good is classified under 3505.10 (Chapter 35) and is manufactured in Sweden (EU) from non-originating materials classified in Chapters 7, 22, 25, 28, and 29. Because all non-originating materials are from chapters other than Chapter 35 and none are from heading 11.08, the good satisfies the CC rule and qualifies as originating in the EU.

deciding_rule: A change to heading 05.01 through 05.11 from any other chapter
reasoning: Following precedents JP1240529, JP1240801, and JP1240709, live bovine animals (Chapter 1) of unspecified origin are treated as non-originating materials. When slaughtered and processed in Canada (a CPTPP party) into bovine aorta classified under subheading 0511.99, the non-originating materials undergo a change in tariff classification from Chapter 1 to Chapter 5. This satisfies the CPTPP Annex 3-D product-specific rule for heading 05.11 requiring a change from any other chapter (CC) under Article 3.2(c).

deciding_rule: CC except from materials of heading 11.08
reasoning: Following precedents JP1241166 and JP1241015, the product-specific rule for heading 35.05 under the Japan-EU EPA is 'CC except from materials of heading 11.08'. The good is classified under 3505.10 (Chapter 35) and is manufactured in Sweden from non-originating materials of Chapters 7, 22, 25, 28, and 29. Because all non-originating materials are from outside Chapter 35 and none are from heading 11.08, the good satisfies the CC requirement and qualifies as an originating good of the EU.

deciding_rule: CTH with tolerance (de minimis) or originating material
reasoning: Under the Japan-EU EPA, the product-specific rule for subheading 2106.90 (other food preparations) is CTH (change of tariff heading), with specific conditions on certain agricultural inputs not present here. Manufactured in Poland (EU), materials ① and ③–⑦ are classified outside heading 21.06 and satisfy CTH. Material ② (heading 21.06) is either originating or within the 10% de minimis tolerance under Article 3.6, enabling the final product to qualify as an EU originating good.
